title: Bounded Simulation of Repeated Steps
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb N$, let $x$ be a finite binary input, let $M$ be a $k$-tape machine with binary work tapes and states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, and let $c$ be one of its configurations whose state is present. Let $d$ be a configuration of the round machine on $x$, at the live entry, representing $c$ and the transition table of $M$. Let $w$ be a finite binary word, let $ct:\mathbb Z\to\{\text{absent},0,1\}$ be a tape and $cp\in\mathbb Z$ a head position, and suppose that for every integer $p$ with $-1\le p\le |w|$, the tape cell at $cp+p$ contains the symbol of $w$ at position $p$ (with positions outside the word blank). If the binary numeral whose digits are the bits of $w$ has value $t$, then there exist a time $T$, a configuration $e$, and a tape $ct'$ such that $T\le t\,50(L+1)+4t+2|w|+2$, where $L$ is the encoded transition-table length; moreover, whenever the original machine has halted by a time $t'\le t$, one has $T\le t'\,50(L+1)+4t'+2|w|$. The configuration $e$ represents the configuration of $M$ after $t$ steps and has the same output as $d$. The tape $ct'$ agrees with $ct$ outside the interval of cells from $cp$ through $cp+|w|-1$. At time $T$, the counter-loop machine, started from the specified initial counter-loop configuration built from $d$, $ct$, and $cp$, is at the configuration built from $e$ and $ct'$, with state determined by whether $M$'s configuration after $t$ steps has a present state: it is the completed state if present, and the escape state otherwise. At every time $u<T$, its state is neither the completed state nor the escape state.
hypotheses_covered: Machine $M$ with $k$ binary work tapes and states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$
Integer-indexed tape $ct$ with optional binary symbols
For every integer $p$ from $-1$ through $|w|$, $ct(cp+p)$ equals the buffered word symbol at $p$
Natural number $t$ equals the base-two value of the bits of $w$
caveat: The tape hypothesis uses the stated buffered-word convention: positions outside the word, including the left boundary position, are blank.
